spans.s: मुकंदक m. An onion.
मुकु m. 1. Liberation; 2. final emancipation.
मुकुट n. 1. A tiara, a crown, मुकुटरत्नमरीचिभिरस्पृशन् R.xi.13; 2. a peak, a point.
मुकुटि f. Snapping the fingers.
मुकुंद m. 1. An epithet of Viṣṇu, मुकुंदमुखचंदिरे चिरमिदं चकोरायताम् Bh.V.iv.1; 2. quick-silver; 3. a kind of precious stone; 4. a kind of drum; 5. one of the nine treasures of Kubera.
मुकुर m. 1. A mirror, स्वमहिमदर्शनमक्ष्णोर्मुकुरतले जायते यस्मात् Vas.D.; 2. a bud; 3. the handle of a potter’s wheel.
मुकुल m.n. 1. A bud, मुकुलजालमशोभत किंशुके R.ix.31, Megh.i.21, R.xv.99; 2. anything shaped like a bud, e.g. दंतमुकुल; 3. the body; 4. the soul.
मुकुलित a. (f. ता) 1. Budded, blossoming; 2. half-closed, half-shut.
मुकुलित a. (f. ता) 1. Budded, blossoming; 2. half-closed, half-shut.
मुकुष्ठ m. A kind of bean.
मुकुष्ठ m. A kind of bean.

मुक्त (I) a. (f. क्ता) 1. Loosened, relaxed; 2. liberated, released; 3. abandoned, quitted; 4. granted, bestowed; 5. emitted; 6. thrown, discharged, hurled; 7. finally emancipated, emancipated from worldly existence, (pp. of मुच् q.v.).
मुक्त (II) m. A saint who has given up all worldly concerns and has prepared his way to final emancipation, हारोयं हरिणाक्षीणां लुठति स्तनमंडले । मुक्तानामप्यवस्थेयं के वयं स्मरकिंकराः Am.

मुक्त (I) a. (f. क्ता) 1. Loosened, relaxed; 2. liberated, released; 3. abandoned, quitted; 4. granted, bestowed; 5. emitted; 6. thrown, discharged, hurled; 7. finally emancipated, emancipated from worldly existence, (pp. of मुच् q.v.).
मुक्ता f. 1. A pearl, Am.
; (for the enumeration of the various sources of pearls, See Mall. on K.S.i.6); 2. a harlot, a prostitute.
मुक्त-अंबर m. a Jaina ascetic of the Digambara sect.
मुक्त-अवयव a. depressed in spirit.
मुक्त-आत्मन् m. 1. the soul released from matter; 2. one whose soul is emancipated.
मुक्त-कच्छ m. a Buddhist.
मुक्त-कंचुक m. a snake that has recently cast its slough.
मुक्त-कर a. liberal, bountiful.
मुक्त-चक्षुस् m. a lion.
मुक्त-वसन m. See मुक्तांबर.
मुक्त-हस्त a. liberal, bountiful.
मुक्तक n. 1. A missile weapon; 2. a śloka the meaning of which is complete in itself; See K.D.x.13; 3. simple prose.
मुक्ता-अगार, -आगार m. the pearl-oyster.
मुक्ता-अगार, -आगार m. the pearl-oyster.
मुक्ता-आवलि, -आवली ऋ।, -कलाप म्। f. a pearl-necklace.
मुक्ता-आवलि, -आवली ऋ।, -कलाप म्। f. a pearl-necklace.
मुक्ता-कलाप m. a pearl-necklace.
मुक्ता-गुण m. 1. a string of pearls, Megh.i.46; 2. the lustre of a pearl, R.xvi.18.
मुक्ता-जाल n. a zone of pearls.
मुक्ता-दामन् n. a string of pearls.
मुक्ता-पुष्प m. a kind of jasmine.
मुक्ता-प्रसू f. the pearl-oystor.
मुक्ता-प्रालंब m. a string of pearls.
मुक्ता-फल n. 1. a pearl, R.vi.28; 2. a kind of flower; 3. camphor; 4. the custard apple.
मुक्ता-मणि m. a pearl.
मुक्ता-मातृ f. the pearl-oyster.
मुक्ता-लता, -स्रज् ऋ।, -हार म्। f. a pearl-necklace.
मुक्ता-लता, -स्रज् ऋ।, -हार म्। f. a pearl-necklace.
मुक्ता-हार m. a pearl-necklace.
मुक्ता-शुक्ति f. the pearl-oyster.
मुक्ता-स्फोट m. the pearl-oyster.

मुक्ति f. 1. Deliverance, liberation, freedom; 2. giving up, leaving off, abandonment, e.g. संसर्गमुक्तिः खले; 3. letting off, discharging, throwing; 4. opening, unloosing; 5. delivery of the soul from further transmigration.
मुक्ति-क्षेत्र n. an epithet of Benares.
मुक्ति-मार्ग m. the way to final liberation.
मुक्ति-मुक्त m. incense.
मूक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Dumb, mute, silent, K.S.iii.42; 2. poor, wretched.
मूक (II) m. 1. A mute, M.vii.149; 2. a poor man; 3. a fish.
मूक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Dumb, mute, silent, K.S.iii.42; 2. poor, wretched.
मूक-भाव m. silence, dumbness.
मूकिमन् m. Silence, dumbness.
